items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: I say, "Now, Bill, I'm going to rehearse your act and I'm going to clean it up.

ctx.x: We're going to rehearse the opening number and rehearse Bill Robinson's music. I'm going to clean up his act -- going to do his act.

Not going to rehearse it in New York. I'm going to rehearse his act here. I say, "Now, Bill, I'm going to rehearse your act and I'm going to clean it up. You're going to do your act here, and I won't have to do it in New York. Because I have a lot of work to do when I get to New York."
